BetterTube is a privacy-friendly YouTube client for Android, forked from [LibreTube](https://github.com/libre-tube/LibreTube). Its audio-only mode really saves data, and the whole app has been redesigned to feel calm, modern and fast.

## Install

Download **`BetterTube-v0.3.7.apk`** below and open it on your phone. Android may ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. BetterTube installs next to the official LibreTube app.

> [!NOTE]
> **Already on v0.2.x or v0.3.x?** This installs as an update and keeps your data.
>
> **Coming from a v0.1.x preview?** Those were a separate test app, so move over once: in the old BetterTube, Settings → Backup and restore → **Backup**; install this version; in the new BetterTube, **Restore** the backup; then uninstall the old one.

## What's new in 0.3.7

- **Fixed:** a crash at launch ("did not then call startForeground") when the player resumed in the background.
- **Dock:** the dock now really sits higher, with the mini player just above it.
- **Video player menu (⋮):** shorter, with Quality first; Autoplay, Repeat mode, Resize mode and Sleep timer are gone.
- **Accent colours:** Crimson is now a vibrant, saturated **Red** and Sunset orange a vibrant **Orange**.
- **Downloads:** the progress label shows the numbers on one line and MB/GB below, right-aligned with steady digits, so it no longer jumps around.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
